comment: The receipt scanner is honestly magic. Snap and done.
Scanning receipts is the best part of Tallyweave, saves me so much time.
Love the receipt scanning. Wish approvals emails were quicker.
Exports still broken. Have raised it repeatedly.
Still no way to handle part payments properly. I spend too long fixing invoices.
Receipt capture is spot on every time.
The new approval flow is so much simpler than before.
Scanner gets amounts wrong constantly on our phones.
Fine overall but customers pay me in instalments and I can't show what's left to pay.
Our lawyers actually submit expenses on time now because scanning is so easy.
Approvals are clearer now. Good update.
Invoices look professional and clients pay faster.
Does what we need for a small team.
Price went up again this year for the Starter plan.
